name: How much does a foreclosed bathroom refresh usually cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a foreclosed bathroom refresh usually cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can often keep a foreclosed bathroom refresh affordable if the plumbing, electrical, and layout stay in place. In Colorado, a basic cosmetic refresh is commonly estimated around **$5,000–$12,000**, while more involved remodels cost more.
acceptedAnswer.description: A cosmetic bathroom refresh is often far cheaper than a full remodel because it avoids moving plumbing or walls. In Colorado, many basic refresh projects fall in the mid-thousands, with cost rising fast if hidden damage is found.
